title: Pure Junk
text:
Pure Junk. If I could give it no stars, I would. What a piece of crap.

Norpro, I am not familiar with your brand and after this experience, I will keep it that way. Would it have killed you to indicate which way the batteries go in? Would it have been too expensive to manufacture a way to have the attachments lock in to place? I tried to whip two eggs in a measuring cup and the whipper kept slipping out. Fortunately, Amazon makes returning a breeze.

My advice? Don't waste your time. It wouldn't be worth it even if it were free.
